passages.p: Sam has a red ball. He likes to play with it in the park.
The sun is hot and bright. It helps the plants grow.
Mia planted a seed. She watered it every day. Soon a little flower grew.
Ben was kind to the new boy. He shared his lunch and they became friends.
A frog lives near the pond. It can hop and swim.
Dad made pancakes for breakfast. They were warm and sweet.
The little dog was lost. A kind girl helped it find its way home.
We thank God for a new day. Every morning is a gift.
Long ago, people used candles for light. Now we use electric bulbs.
passages.q: What did people use for light long ago?

passages.p: Ana painted a picture of the sea. She used blue and white.
Two plus two is four. Math can be fun to learn.
The bee flew from flower to flower. It helps make honey.
passages.q: What does the bee help make?

passages.p: Leo read a book about space. He learned that the sun is a star.
It started to rain. Nina opened her umbrella to stay dry.
passages.q: Why did Nina open her umbrella?

passages.p: The farmer woke up early. He fed the cows and the hens.
Grandma told a story about a brave king. The children listened quietly.
The ice cream melted in the hot sun. It became a sticky puddle.
passages.q: Why did the ice cream melt?

passages.p: Tom helped his mom wash the dishes. Then they read a book together.
A spider spins a web to catch its food. The web is sticky and strong.
passages.q: Why does a spider spin a web?

passages.p: The seed grew into a tall tree. Birds built a nest in its branches.
passages.q: Who built a nest in the tree?

passages.p: Jesus told people to love one another. He was kind to everyone.
passages.q: What did Jesus tell people to do?

passages.p: The moon shines at night. It gives us a soft, gentle light.
Kemi lost her shoe at the beach. Her dad helped her find it in the sand.
passages.q: Where did Kemi lose her shoe?

passages.p: The caterpillar ate many leaves. Later it turned into a butterfly.
We planted trees to help the earth. Trees give us fresh air.
The baker made warm bread. The whole shop smelled wonderful.
